newsitem.title: USA: Polaris verdict from trade secrets lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Polaris verdict from trade secrets lawsuit.

text.p: Polaris Industries Inc said Monday the $34 million court verdict against it, which the company said earlier today it will appeal, was related to allegations of misappropriation of trade secrets.
Previously, a judge had dismissed allegations of patent infringement in the suit, Polaris president Ken Larson said.
A jury, however, found that Polaris had allegedly misappropriated trade secrets, Larson said. He reiterated that the company will appeal the court decision.
The suit was brought seven years ago by IRS Inc, which is now part of Echlin Inc, Larson said.
Polaris said earlier that it never misappropriated any other party's ideas or technology.
